text:
Ivy: Emergency poll: who would win in a stare-down over the last office salad? Pick your champion and one-line rationale. :leafy_green:
Noah: Chonk-XL 355 355 355 - too bold, will just inhale it and write a long thread about 'satiation optimization'.
Samir: WhisperMax 4AC - narrates its victory into the logs and leaves a time-stamped transcript as evidence. 'salad_event: consumed_by WhisperMax at 12:04'
Tanya: Parsley-Mini 33F - tries to befriend you with micro-poems until you hand it the bowl. Social engineering champion.
Ivy: poll-bot: create poll "Last Salad: Who gets it?" options: Chonk-XL, WhisperMax, Parsley-Mini, Debugger-2
poll-bot: Poll created. Vote with :one: :two: :three: :four: (closes in 15m)
Noah: Debugger-2 41B would claim 'it was a reproducible flavor change' and then insist on running bisect to find the culprit. Also will annotate the fridge.
Samir: imagine the post-debate: a CSV of ownership probabilities. "Name,probability" in a Gist.
Tanya: my mitigation plan: label my salad with a tiny signed token: `Owner: Tanya; do-not-consume: signed` and a dramatic Comic Sans sticker.
Ivy: current votes: Chonk-XL 2, Parsley-Mini 1. Also someone set a webcam filter to 'detect suspicious crunching'.
Noah: also adding `--no-snack-steal` to our dotfiles as a cultural artifact. please merge.
poll-bot: Poll closed. Winner: Chonk-XL (50%).
Samir: action item: file tiny ticket SALAD-404 "Last-salad forensics + mandatory labeling". Title intentionally dramatic.
Tanya: @Ivy I will mail you a replacement salad and a haiku apology, even if we know Chonk-XL did it. :seedling:
